items.titleZh: 开放权重向导：Chris Alexiuk 通过开放模型让人工智能变得简单

items.summaryZh: NVIDIA 博客报道了人工智能的模型开发。消息来源的关键点：Chris Alexiuk 对于开源人工智能有一个简单的规则：如果你相信它，就大声说出来。
items.summaryEn: NVIDIA Blog reports a model development in AI. Key point from the source: Chris Alexiuk has a simple rule about open source AI: If you believe in it, be loud about it.

items.titleZh: 衡量人工智能代理如何处理日常湿实验室科学
items.titleEn: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
items.summaryZh: OpenAI 博客报道了人工智能的模型开发。来源要点：OpenAI 推出了 BioBasicsBench，这是一个包含 100 项任务的基准测试，用于衡量 AI 代理解释原始实验数据和处理日常湿实验室科学的能力。
items.summaryEn: OpenAI Blog reports a model development in AI. Key point from the source: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.
items.overviewZh: OpenAI 博客发布了关于“衡量人工智能代理如何处理日常湿实验室科学”的最新更新。

items.titleZh: 据报道 OpenAI 额外融资 110 亿美元，估值 1.25 万亿美元
items.titleEn: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
items.summaryZh: TechCrunch AI 报告了人工智能领域的业务发展。消息来源的关键点：据报道，OpenAI 已额外筹集 110 亿美元，作为一轮融资的一部分，该轮融资尚未结束，但预计将在未来几周内结束。
items.summaryEn: TechCrunch AI reports a business development in AI. Key point from the source: OpenAI has reportedly raised an additional $11 billion as part of a funding round that hasn't closed yet but is expected to in the coming weeks.
items.overviewZh: TechCrunch AI 发布了有关“据报道 OpenAI 以 1.25 万亿美元估值额外筹集 110 亿美元”的最新更新。
items.overviewEn: TechCrunch AI published a new update about “OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation”.

items.titleZh: 竞争对手 Anthropic 即将 IPO，OpenAI 估值达 1.25 万亿美元
items.titleEn: OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion, as rival Anthropic nears its IPO
items.summaryZh: The Verge AI 报道了人工智能领域的业务发展。消息来源要点：据彭博社报道，OpenAI 在新一轮融资中目前估值为 1.25 万亿美元，该轮融资又筹集了 110 亿美元。
items.summaryEn: The Verge AI reports a business development in AI. Key point from the source: OpenAI is now valued at $1.25 trillion in a new round of funding that has raised another $11 billion, according to Bloomberg.
